title: Purpose.
bodyText: The legislature hereby declares that the purpose of this chapter is to recodify, without substantive change, the insurance law in effect immediately prior to July 1, 1988.

bodyHtml:
§431:1-100.5  Purpose.  The legislature hereby declares that the purpose of this chapter is to recodify, without substantive change, the insurance law in effect immediately prior to July 1, 1988. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]

 

Revision Note

 

  "July 1, 1988" substituted for "the effective date of this chapter" pursuant to §23G-15.
